scenario.name: south_texas_reversion
scenario.assumption: 50% of the Texas border counties' 2020->2024 presidential swing in excess of the statewide swing reverses in 2026.
scenario.house_rule: Texas seat mean += -fraction * excess_swing * district region share
scenario.senate_rule: Texas Senate mean += -fraction * excess_swing * statewide region share
scenario.not_measured: No 2026 vote, poll or special election from the region supports or rejects the assumption; county aggregates say nothing about how any group of voters moved.
